# Contributing to appimg

We welcome contributions to appimg! Here are the guidelines for contributing:

## How to Contribute

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a new branch for your feature or bug fix
3. Make your changes
4. Write clear, concise commit messages
5. Submit a pull request

## Reporting Issues

If you find a bug or have a feature request, please open an issue on GitHub with:

- A clear title and description
- Steps to reproduce the issue
- Expected vs actual behavior
- System information (OS, version, etc.)

## Code Style

- Use consistent indentation (2 spaces)
- Write clear comments in Spanish
- Follow the existing code structure
- Ensure all functions have error handling

## Testing

Before submitting your changes:

1. Test your code changes locally
2. Ensure the script runs without errors
3. Verify all existing functionality still works

## Feature Requests

We welcome feature requests! Please open an issue describing:

- What problem the feature would solve
- How the feature would work
- Any implementation considerations

Thank you for helping improve appimg!
